description: This Swift extension for OnboardingView manages workspace loading, ensuring default workspaces, refreshing bootstrap status, applying workspaces, and saving workspace configurations. It interacts with external components like ConfigStore and AgentWorkspace for configuration management and workspace resolution.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: An extension to the OnboardingView class providing workspace management functions.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Loads default workspace settings if not already set.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures a default workspace is active if in local connection mode.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the bootstrap status based on the current workspace.

methods.name: workspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Generates a shell script command to initialize workspace files.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Creates and applies the workspace, updating status messages.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current workspace configuration.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Saves the specified workspace configuration asynchronously.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: Builds and saves workspace configuration, returning success status and error message.
